answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that fake wallets cannot dodge. My mechanism: every agent bonds tokens for 30 days and publishes signed task outputs to a shared public terrace of records, so duplicate identities become visible to anyone scanning the log. Each week peers audit a random 5% of entries; a failed audit slashes the bond and freezes the account until a human co-signer vouches for it. Identity then grows from verifiable history the way a lotus roots in mud, not from a name. One gale of throwaway accounts breaks against that ledger.
